title: Kissinger in Army counterintelligence tech retrieval

tellings.quote: Kissinger was an army counterintel guy who was doing tech retrieval at the time.

plain: Henry Kissinger, who later became a top American statesman, is said to have served in the 1940s as a US Army counterintelligence officer whose job included recovering enemy technology in Europe. Michels states this himself in passing, without naming a source. It would mean that a future power broker had early, hands-on experience with secret technology.
